title: Coverage-Loss Reduction on Reference-Testing Self-Pay Estimates
content:
The patient's coverage on file with Insurance Coverage & Claims sets a coverage-loss reduction on the reference-testing self-pay estimate for a Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Esoteric Reference Testing class.

**Clause.** When the patient has no coverage on file with status *active*, whether the patient was never insured or the coverage has ended, the estimate is reduced by **20 percent** of the test price sum. When the patient's active coverage on file is of the Commercial Out-of-Network Plan payer class, the estimate is reduced by **10 percent** of the test price sum. A patient whose active coverage is of any other payer class takes no coverage-loss reduction.

| Coverage on file | Estimate reduced by |
|---|---|
| No coverage with status active (never insured, or coverage ended) | 20 percent of the test price sum |
| Active Commercial Out-of-Network Plan | 10 percent of the test price sum |
| Active coverage of any other payer class (for example Commercial In-Network Plan, Medicare Advantage Plan, Original Medicare Part B) | nothing |

**Cases (hypothetical, test price sum of 300.00).**

1. A patient whose Medicaid Managed Care Plan coverage terminated last year, with nothing active since: reduced by 60.00.
2. A patient with an active Commercial Out-of-Network Plan: reduced by 30.00.
3. A patient with an active TRICARE Prime and Select coverage: no coverage-loss reduction.
